auth.pendingTitle: Wait for the verification from Agent OS.
auth.pendingBody: {{email}} is signed in but hasn't been approved yet. This page updates on its own once that happens — no need to keep refreshing.
auth.checkEmail: Check {{email}} for a confirmation link. This page moves on by itself once you click it — even if you do it in another tab.
auth.signUpIntro: Create an account to get started.
auth.switchToSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in

errors.user_already_exists: An account with this email already exists.
errors.email_not_confirmed: Confirm your email first — check your inbox for the link.
errors.weak_password: Choose a stronger password (at least 6 characters).
errors.over_email_send_rate_limit: Too many emails sent. Wait a minute and try again.

auth.resetIntro: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
auth.resetSent: If {{email}} has an Agent OS account, a link to set a new password is on its way. Check spam too.
auth.alreadyRegistered: Already have an account with this email? No email is sent in that case. Sign in, or use "Forgot password?".

privacy.ownerPrivate: Owner names, phones and private notes are never shared with colleagues
privacy.clientPrivate: Client names and phone numbers are never part of a shared requirement
privacy.privateRequirements: Private requirements never take part in agency-wide matching

demo.body: For walkthroughs — preview the read-only state after a trial ends. This only changes your view for this session; your real trial status is managed by an admin.
demo.overrideNote: Testing override is on — the app stays fully editable whichever state is selected. Set TESTING_FULL_ACCESS to false to restore normal trial behaviour.
